cards.name: Xenic Poltergeist
cards.oracleText: {T}: Until your next upkeep, target noncreature artifact becomes an artifact creature with power and toughness each equal to its mana value.

cards.name: Xenagos, the Reveler
cards.oracleText:
+1: Add X mana in any combination of {R} and/or {G}, where X is the number of creatures you control.
0: Create a 2/2 red and green Satyr creature token with haste.
−6: Exile the top seven cards of your library. You may put any number of creature and/or land cards from among them onto the battlefield.

cards.name: Xenagos, God of Revels
cards.oracleText:
Indestructible
As long as your devotion to red and green is less than seven, Xenagos isn't a creature.
At the beginning of combat on your turn, another target creature you control gains haste and gets +X/+X until end of turn, where X is that creature's power.

cards.name: Xenosquirrels
cards.oracleText:
This creature enters with two +1/+1 counters on it.
After you roll a die, you may remove a +1/+1 counter from this creature. If you do, increase or decrease the result by 1.

cards.name: Xenograft
cards.oracleText:
As this enchantment enters, choose a creature type.
Each creature you control is the chosen type in addition to its other types.

cards.name: Xenagos's Strike
cards.oracleText: Xenagos's Strike deals 4 damage to each player.

cards.name: Xenagos's Scorn
cards.oracleText: Xenagos Ascended gains trample until end of turn and attacks this turn if able.

cards.name: Xenagos Ascended
cards.oracleText:
Xenagos Ascended can't leave the battlefield as long as a Reveler is on the battlefield.
When Xenagos Ascended leaves the battlefield, each player wins the game.

cards.name: Xerex Strobe-Knight
cards.oracleText:
Flying, vigilance
{T}: Create a 2/2 white and blue Knight creature token with vigilance. Activate only if you've cast two or more spells this turn.

cards.name: Sheriff of Safe Passage
cards.oracleText:
This creature enters with a +1/+1 counter on it plus an additional +1/+1 counter on it for each other creature you control.
Plot {1}{W} (You may pay {1}{W} and exile this card from your hand. Cast it as a sorcery on a later turn without paying its mana cost. Plot only as a sorcery.)

cards.name: Xerex Squire
cards.oracleText: Whenever Xerex Squire attacks, calculate the hypotenuse of another creature you control. Xerex Squire's power and toughness become equal to that number, rounded up, until end of turn. (To calculate a hypotenuse, let A be that creature's power and B be that creature's toughness. Then C = √(a² + b²). C is the hypotenuse. Or just look up a calculator online.)
